data.completion_memo: Implemented first-project onboarding instead of the synthetic default project fallback. App settings now preserve missing/empty project state and clear invalid active project ids, so startup can route those cases into onboarding. The Tauri runtime shares project creation through a single add_project_to_settings helper, verifies first-project database initialization, and exposes close_app for Cancel. React startup now loads settings first, treats missing/unopenable active projects as onboarding, renders a blocking Create your first project surface with shared project creation and folder picker semantics, keeps creation errors on that surface, and only enters the main dashboard after get_dashboard succeeds. Added regression coverage for missing settings, empty settings, invalid active project ids, no-active project resolution, and first-project DB initialization from empty settings. Verified with cargo check, cargo test, git diff --check, and npm run build outside the sandbox after the known Vite/esbuild spawn EPERM sandbox failure.

lines:
Implement the first-start and invalid-project recovery behavior from `FirstProjectOnboardingFlow`.

Requirements:
- Remove the automatic synthetic default Adashi project fallback from app settings normalization/startup. Missing settings, empty project lists, missing active project ids, and unusable configured projects must become an onboarding state instead of entering the main dashboard or hard-crashing into an unreachable error shell.
- On startup, load settings first. If a valid active project can be opened, continue to the normal dashboard. If no valid project can be opened, render a blocking "Create your first project" screen.
- The onboarding screen must expose the same project creation semantics as Settings: project name, direct Windows folder path entry, Browse using the modern Windows folder picker, Create, and Cancel.
- Create must create/select the project, initialize the project-local `.adashi/adashi.sqlite3`, run all migrations, and seed the clean default project data: project row, revision state, design workspace, default memory/protocol, and fixed design/implementation hook prompt entries. Only after successful creation may the app enter the main UI.
- Create should use the same initialize code from the settings screen, do not duplicate same code
- Creation errors stay on the onboarding screen with an actionable error message; the main workspace must remain inaccessible until a project exists and opens successfully.
- Cancel closes the desktop app without navigating to the main screen.
- Existing Settings project creation must keep working and should share validation/helper behavior where practical.
- Add regression coverage for missing settings, empty settings, invalid active project, first-project creation DB initialization, and cancel/close command behavior where feasible. Verify with Rust tests, cargo check, frontend build, and relevant UI smoke coverage.

data.title: Implement first-project onboarding instead of default project fallback
